fact: CAPMAS head said the census form for the 2027 census was finished, a comprehensive cartographic enumeration giving each building a national real-estate number was under way, and a plan was submitted to the Prime Minister in June 2025.
title: رقم قومي لكل عقار.. الإحصاء يبدأ الحصر الخرائطي استعدادًا لتعداد 2027
